outcome: maternal complications (HELLP syndrome, renal complications, pulmonary edema, cerebral venous thrombosis)
neonatal complications (low birth weight, preterm birth, small for gestational age)
cohort: 8941 women with more than 20 weeks of gestation, admitted for delivery at Koppal Institute of Medical Sciences between July 2019 and June 2021
finding: The proportions of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and eclampsia were 10.64% and 1.9%, respectively.
mod_finding: 41.7% of the women with hypertensive disorders underwent lower segment cesarean section.
